title: Poker: Texas Hold'em
context: You have the time to read this explanation. Afterwards you will get 3 questions about the topic. YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO GO BACK TO THE EXPLANATION!

easy.prompt:
Your hand: 9♥ 4♥ 
Opponent's hand: 10♣ J♦ 
Board: 7♥ 8♠ 9♣ Q♥ 2♥ 
On the river, the pot is €200 and the opponent goes all-in for €150. 
Knowing both hands, do you call or fold?

medium.prompt:
Your hand: A♣ 3♦ 
Opponent's hand: K♠ K♥ 
Board: 2♥ 4♣ 5♠ K♦ 9♣ 
On the river, the pot is €200 and the opponent goes all-in for €150. 
Knowing both hands, do you call or fold?

hard.prompt:
Your hand: A♥ J♥ 
Opponent's hand: K♣ K♠ 
Board after the turn: K♥ 7♥ 2♣ 4♦ 
One card, the river, is still to come. The pot is €100 and the opponent bets €50. Knowing both hands, do you call or fold?
